name: AgenticSeek
title: fosowl.github.io/agenticSeek
shortDescription: AgenticSeek is a voice-enabled AI assistant that operates fully locally, designed for users who prioritize privacy. It supports autonomous web browsing, code writing in multiple languages, and complex task management. Ideal for developers and researchers, AgenticSeek can autonomously perform tasks like researching project requirements or analyzing data without relying on cloud services.
cons: Limited to local resources and processing power
